title: Answer
description:
Throne and priesthood are one appointment, spoken to one man. An oath does what descent cannot, and a priest outside that descent would have died under the old rule.

The text about the king-priest says only what it says. Filling in his family is adding.

Heard means the forsaken cry was not despised. Learning obedience is the opened ear and the back given to the strikers, not a cure for sin.
